title: Complete WirelessHack playlist import
notes: Imports every distinct stream URL exposed by every playlist on the referenced WirelessHack page, including regional and category subsets, Plex tokenised entries and the full IPTV-org M3U. The library contains 25,256 unique stream URLs with provider/country disambiguation for repeated titles and 157,588 real guide entries. Health results are reported but do not remove site-supplied rows. Existing favourites, folders, hidden channels, settings, add-ons and logins are preserved; one background catalogue refresh runs after the interface is responsive.
